detail.longDescription: Hister v0.19.0 is out! This release adds ChatGPT and Hacker News extractors, Safari history imports, URL regexp search, safer skip rule cleanup, richer previews and suggestions, and a more predictable TUI that can inherit your terminal colors. It also improves index maintenance, OAuth requests, caching, and user administration. Release notes and downloads: https:// github.com/asciimoo/hister/rel eases/tag/v0.19.0 # freesoftware # SelfHosted # Search # opensource
